options.name: bearer_token
options.description: The NetScaler Console Cloud bearer token.

options.name: cb_profile_name
options.description: Profile Name, This is one of the already created Citrix SD-WAN profiles.

options.name: customer_id
options.description: The NetScaler Console Cloud customer id.

options.name: host_password
options.description: Host Password for this profile.Used for BLX form factor of Console.  Minimum length =  1  Maximum length =  127 This attribute cannot be updated. Delete and recreate the profile instead.

options.name: host_username
options.description: Host User Name for this profile.Used for BLX form factor of Console.  Minimum length =  1  Maximum length =  127

options.name: http_port
options.description: HTTP port to connect to the device.

options.name: https_port
options.description: HTTPS port to connect to the device.

options.name: id
options.description: Id is system generated key for all the device profiles.

options.name: instance_ip
options.description: The target Netscaler instance ip address to which all underlying NITRO API calls will be proxied to. It is meaningful only when having set C(netscaler_console_proxy_call) to C(true)

options.name: is_cloud
options.description: Boolean flag. Set to true when executing modules against the Console service.

options.name: max_wait_time_reboot
options.description: Max waiting time to reboot NetScaler Console.

options.name: name
options.description: Profile Name.  Minimum length =  1  Maximum length =  128

options.name: netscaler_console_proxy_call
options.description: If true the underlying NITRO API calls made by the module will be proxied through a NetScaler Console node to the target Netscaler instance. When true you must also define the following options: I(nitro_auth_token), I(instance_ip).

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the netscaler node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_timeout
options.description: Time in seconds until a timeout error is thrown when establishing a new session with Netscaler

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the netscaler node.

options.name: ns_profile_name
options.description: Profile Name, This is one of the already created NetScaler Console profiles.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the netscaler appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: passphrase
options.description: Passphrase with which private key is encrypted. This attribute cannot be updated. Delete and recreate the profile instead.

options.name: password
options.description: Instance credentials.Password for this profile.  Minimum length =  1  Maximum length =  127 This attribute cannot be updated. Delete and recreate the profile instead.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If true the module will save the configuration on the netscaler node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the netscaler node if it made no changes.

options.name: snmpauthpassword
options.description: SNMP v3 auth password for this profile.  Minimum length =  8  Maximum length =  31 This attribute cannot be updated. Delete and recreate the profile instead.

options.name: snmpauthprotocol
options.description: SNMP v3 auth protocol for this profile.

options.name: snmpcommunity
options.description: SNMP community for this profile.  Maximum length =  31

options.name: snmpprivpassword
options.description: SNMP v3 priv password for this profile.  Minimum length =  8  Maximum length =  31 This attribute cannot be updated. Delete and recreate the profile instead.

options.name: snmpprivprotocol
options.description: SNMP v3 priv protocol for this profile.

options.name: snmpsecuritylevel
options.description: SNMP v3 security level for this profile.

options.name: snmpsecurityname
options.description: SNMP v3 security name for this profile.  Maximum length =  31

options.name: snmpversion
options.description: SNMP version for this profile.

options.name: ssh_port
options.description: SSH port to connect to the device.

options.name: ssl_cert
options.description: SSL Certificate for certificate based authentication.

options.name: ssl_private_key
options.description: SSL Private Key for key based authentication.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the netscaler node. When present the resource will be created if needed and configured according to the module's parameters. When absent the resource will be deleted from the netscaler node.

options.name: svm_ns_comm
options.description: Communication protocol (http or https) with Instances.  Minimum length =  1  Maximum length =  10

options.name: type
options.description: Profile Type, This must be with in specified supported instance types:  Minimum length =  1  Maximum length =  128

options.name: use_global_setting_for_communication_with_ns
options.displayName: Use Global Setting For Communication With Ns
options.description: True, if the communication with Instance needs to be global and not device specific.

options.name: username
options.description: Instance credentials.Username provided in the profile will be used to contact the instance.  Minimum length =  1  Maximum length =  127

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
